title: Scope or ticket the FlutterError.onError overflow suppression in profile_picker_screen_l1_test.dart and rpr2_picker_offline_delete_test.dart he-locale tests
why: Both overrides swallow every RenderFlex-overflow FlutterError raised anywhere in the pumped tree for the remainder of the test, not just the one 'residual small profile-grid' overflow the comment names, and neither comment cites a Linear DNI-#### id (only 'tracked for the Phase 8 RTL/visual sweep'). Any new, unrelated overflow introduced later in the Hebrew-locale render of ProfilePickerScreen (or, in rpr2, the manage-sheet/confirm-dialog chain) will pass silently instead of failing CI, on an RTL app where directional-layout overflow is a named risk (AX-1).
recommendation: Narrow the filter to the specific known widget (match its key/type in the error details), or replace the blanket catch with a `// TODO(DNI-####): remove once <widget> RTL overflow is fixed` plus a scoped skip, so unrelated future overflows still fail the test.
acceptance_criteria: Introducing a synthetic RenderFlex overflow in an unrelated widget within the same pumped tree causes these two tests to fail again.
